description: Citywide Bicycle Counts is a dataset listed in City of Cambridge open data portal (data.cambridgema.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Cambridge. This bicycle count data is collected as part of the City of Cambridge’s regular citywide bicycle counts. These counts are typically done on weekdays (Tuesday-Thursday) in September, annually between 2002-2006 and every other year since 2008, with an additional count in 2019 due to poor weather in 2018. Coverage: Cambridge, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are bicycle count, transportation, bicycles. The table has 17 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Cambridge. The portal shows 2025-02-18 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cambridgema-gov-portal.
